title: Primary Logo / Primary Logo for Small Use
slide_intent: Provide a simplified signature for small formats so recognition survives reproduction limits.
strategic_value: A small-use variant can keep Burger King’s burger-shaped mark readable across touchpoints.
demonstration: Two left text blocks explain primary and small-use logos; a large signature and a tiny annotated version occupy the right.
practical_value: Choose the small-use logo when the required width is .75 inch or less; consult minimum-size guidance separately.
